usage.desc: Onboarding, a feature tour, a carousel. Anything that is one full panel at a time rather than a list.
Generic over the item type, like a list: the slide content is yours to render.
Per slide: one colour paints flat, several become a Gradient behind the content.
Advances on its own and pauses while a finger is dragging. showAutoPlayToggle is on by default because content that moves on its own needs a way to stop it (WCAG 2.2.2).
Dots or numbers, laid over the slide in white or outside it in theme colours.
Controlled or uncontrolled, the same pair as the rest of the library.

autoPlay.description: Advances on its own. Pauses while a finger is dragging.

background.description: Background per slide: `'#101014'` paints flat, `['#004cef', '#00cae1']` makes a gradient.

gradientDirection.description: Direction of the gradient when `background` returns several colours.

index.description: Controlled index. Without it, the component keeps its own starting from `defaultIndex`.

indicatorPlacement.description:
'overlay' rests them on the slide, in white; 'outside' moves them out
of the swipeable area, in theme colours.

loop.description: After the last one it goes back to the first (and the other way round).

renderItem.description: Slide content: images, buttons, whatever. Drawn on top of `background`.

showAutoPlayToggle.description:
Button to stop the automatic advance. Only appears with `autoPlay`, and
defaults to `true` because content that moves on its own needs a way to
pause it (WCAG 2.2.2).

slideStyle.description: Styles for the visible box of each slide — padding, alignment, radius.

spacing.description: Gap between slides, in px. At 0 they sit flush.
